dedupe_keys.name: onset of mining operations first observable mining year for maus et al mining polygons landsat 1990 2020

description: This dataset infers the first observable year of mining for each mining area polygon in the Maus and others global mining database, which is otherwise static. The Zenodo record says 50 samples inside and 50 along the border of each polygon were drawn, Landsat spectral profiles from 1990 to 2020 were extracted in Google Earth Engine with cloud masking, the inside and outside profiles were compared by RMSE, and a knee detection algorithm found the change year. It was produced by Ruben Remelgado and Carsten Meyer of the German Centre for Integrative Biodiversity Research for the GlobES project, and published in August 2023 as one open zip of about 1.7 GB, free to download; the licence is not stated on the page read. Coverage is global. Caveats: onset years are inferred from spectral change and limited to the Landsat era. For simulation it adds mine age to the global mining footprint for modelling mining expansion, land use change and supply growth. Related catalogue records include the Maus global mining polygons and the Tang and Werner global mining footprints.
name: Onset of mining operations - first observable mining year for Maus et al. mining polygons (Landsat, 1990-2020)
